title: A Unified Control-Theoretic Framework for Saddle-Point Dynamics in Constrained Optimization
summary: This paper studies equality-constrained minimization problems through the lens of feedback control. We introduce a unified control-theoretic framework by showing that a PID feedback law acting on the dual variable induces the PID saddle-point flow (PID-SPF), a broad class of saddle-point dynamics associated with the augmented Lagrangian. This framework recovers several classical primal-dual flows as special cases. We prove that the equilibria of the proposed flow coincide with the stationary points of the original problem.
